# Feature digest — generated, do not edit

One line per feature so an agent can see the whole shape cheaply. **`feature_list.json` remains
the source of truth** — but do not open it to read one entry. `node tools/feature.mjs <id>`
prints the full entry (behavior, verification, falsifier, evidence, checkerNotes) without loading
the whole file, and `--deps <id>` says whether it is eligible yet.
